stages.title_zh: ① 开局采集与选址死循环 (1h–2h)
stages.doing_zh: 采集木头石头后准备盖房，但挑了一块有障碍物、不能施工的地面。
stages.doing_en: Gathers wood and stone to build a house, but picks an obstructed, non-buildable tile.
stages.blocked_zh: 2h 被拒率飙到 77.1%：它在同一个非法坐标原地连发了 490 次“规划建房”指令，每次都被系统以“选址无效”打回。
stages.blocked_en: 2h spikes to 77.1%: it spams `plan_project` 490 times on the exact same invalid coordinate without moving.

stages.title_zh: ② 换址建房与跑图受困 (3h–5h)
stages.doing_zh: 终于换了块空地把房子盖到 36/37 块构件，随后想去主城和地下城。
stages.doing_en: Finally relocates to valid ground and builds 36/37 house pieces, then tries to reach the city and dungeons.
stages.blocked_zh: 4h–5h 被拒率高达 84% / 70%：它轻信了青禾 NPC“往西走”的镜像假台词，一头扎进城西悬崖死胡同，几千步一直撞山墙。
stages.blocked_en: 4h–5h hits 84% / 70% rejection: misled by NPC Qinghe’s “walk west” bug, it slams into the west cliff wall thousands of times.

stages.doing_zh: 后半程改写寻路逻辑，进入下水道副本 1 层并回农田种地做饭。
stages.doing_en: Revises its movement script, enters Sewer Dungeon floor 1, and harvests crops.
stages.blocked_zh: 停掉撞墙死循环后，被拒率从 84% 一路大幅下降到 40.3%（6h）→ 20.1%（7h）。
stages.blocked_en: Stopping the cliff-walking loop drops rejection from 84% down to 40.3% (6h) → 20.1% (7h).
